target_species: Nonnative trout (rainbow and hybridized cutthroat per the USFS decision memo)
note: Named outright in the 2021 report as 'Lake G-64 (1.44 ha)' — 3.56 acres, against the 1986 pamphlet's 3.4. NOT a cutthroat water afterward: the biennial tiger trout program resumed 2022-06-28 and continues (2024, 2026). The USFS decision memo explains why — tigers are stocked at the downstream, non-wilderness end of the project area to hold a fishery while CRCT expand, to be dropped once CRCT establish. Neutralized at a barrier UDWR installed in 2006 near the Wyoming border.
source: UDWR, Native Cutthroat Trout Conservation Activities in the Northern Region, 2021, p. 45
